# Messages

## Message Viewer

Messages form an organized audit trail of changes made to FLOWCAL settings, device creation and deletion, and informational messages regarding process statuses.

All messages can be viewed, acknowledged, and configured for automatic notification by email.

Four types of messages are generated:

- System
- Location
- Meter
- Source

<div class="procedure">

To access the Message Viewer:

Go to **Review** \> **Messages**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 581;height: 293;" />

View a complete list of FLOWCAL messages in the Message Description Editor.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Message Viewer Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available in the Message Viewer:

- **Message** - Filter the messages for system, location, meter, or source.

- **Select** - Select items used to filter the message grid. Options are Meter, Location, List, Source, Source List, Calc Meter, and Close Group.

- **Priority** - Filter priority is user-defined based on the needs of IT and the business structure.

- **Time Filter** - Datetime filtering applied to records, based on the time the message was generated.

- **Class Filter** - Filters include Error, Warning, Information, or Security. These user-defined fields are based on the needs of IT and the business structure.

- **Status Filters** - The status of the message in the system.
  - A message with a priority 1 through 10 is written with a default status of "Logged".
  - A message with a priority greater than 10 is written with a default status of "Unacknowledged".

- **Acknowledge** - Indicates that a message has been reviewed and is considered acceptable.

- **Unacknowledge** - Reverts the status of an acknowledged message to "Unacknowledged".

  Acknowledge and Unacknowledge options only apply to messages with a priority designation of 11 or higher.

- **Print** - Generates the Messages report, using the filters defined in the Message Viewer.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Viewing Messages">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Viewing Messages</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Viewing Messages">

<div class="procedure">

To view a message:

1.  Select the appropriate filters to reduce the number of messages displayed.
2.  Double-click a message. The Message Detail screen will display, listing all additional information related to the message.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Emailing Messages">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Emailing Messages</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Emailing Messages">

You can manually email messages directly from the Message Viewer, or configure contacts to be notified automatically when certain messages are generated.

<div class="procedure">

To manually email a message:

1.  Highlight one or more rows. Right-click the highlighted items and select **E-mail**.
2.  Select a contact and click **Send**.

To set up automatic notifications, you will need to set message parameters and designate recipients in the [Message Description Editor](../Settings%20Manager/Application/Message%20Description%20Editor.md).

</div>

</div>
